quota_name: [EventsV2] Combined ingestion throughput and count per Event Group per second
description: The maximum event throughput per Event Group per Second. Counted as the sum of (number of events) + (total size of those events in KB) delivered to a given event group within any one-second window.
The maximum number of V2 Event Buses owned by this account per Region. Does not include buses shared with this account.
The maximum number of Event Sources owned by this account per Region.

quota_name: [EventsV2] Events per second per custom event bus
description: The maximum number of events per second ingested per custom event bus, counted across all event sources and all accounts the bus is shared with.

quota_name: [EventsV2] Resource policy size per event bus
description: The maximum size, in bytes, of the customer-managed (default) resource policy of a V2 event bus. Policies that AWS Resource Access Manager writes for a shared bus do not count against this quota.
The maximum number of Subscribers that can be associated with each V2 Event Bus owned by this account, across all accounts it is shared with.
The maximum number of API destinations per account per Region.
The maximum number of connections per account per Region.

quota_name: CreateEndpoint throttle limit in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of requests per second for CreateEndpoint API. Additional requests are throttled.

quota_name: DeleteEndpoint throttle limit in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of requests per second for DeleteEndpoint API. Additional requests are throttled.
The maximum number of endpoints per account per Region.
Maximum policy size, in characters. This policy size increases each time you grant access to another account. You can see your current policy and its size by using the DescribeEventBus API.
Maximum event buses per account.
Maximum size of an event pattern, in characters.

quota_name: Invocations throttle limit in transactions per second
description: An invocation is an event matching a rule and being sent on to the rule's targets. After the limit is reached, the invocations are throttled; that is, they still happen but they are delayed.
Maximum number of rules an account can have per event bus

quota_name: PutEvents throttle limit in transactions per second
description: Maximum number of requests per second for PutEvents API. Additional requests are throttled.

quota_name: Rate of invocations per API destination
description: The maximum number of invocations per second to send to each API destination endpoint per account per Region. Once the quota is met, future invocations to that API endpoint are throttled. The invocations will still occur, but are delayed.
Maximum number of targets that can be associated with a rule

quota_name: Throttle limit in transactions per second for control plane APIs
description: Maximum number of requests per second for EventBridge control plane API operations. Additional requests are throttled.

quota_name: UpdateEndpoint throttle limit in transactions per second
description: The maximum number of requests per second for UpdateEndpoint API. Additional requests are throttled.
